observation.visible_scene: A dim stone corridor with a cobblestone floor running toward the camera. At the far end a bright rectangular doorway is strongly backlit, and a slim humanoid silhouette stands motionless inside it. In the left foreground a dark, multi-limbed shadow figure is stationary. On the right a stone wall is crossed by a diagonal beam of light that casts a long shadow onto the floor. The scene is high-contrast: almost everything is in darkness except the glowing doorway and the lit strip on the right wall.
visible_changes: No object motion is discernible across the sampled frames: the doorway silhouette keeps the same pose and screen position, the left shadow figure stays in place, and the right-wall beam and floor shadows do not visibly move.
The bright doorway glow and the surrounding darkness remain at constant intensity throughout.
The excerpt reads as a static interval; only negligible frame-to-frame lighting noise is present.
The two figures (backlit doorway silhouette and foreground left shadow) remain separate and do not interact.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether any figure begins to move before or after this crop boundary.
The identity or nature of the left shadow figure.
The source and meaning of the doorway light and the right-wall beam.
uncertain_details: A possible very slight shift in the edge of the right-wall light between early and late frames, which may be subtle camera drift or rendering/flicker rather than physical motion.
Whether the leg positions of the left shadow differ marginally across frames or are identical.
